lessons.advice: When changing timezone SQL handling, distinguish named zones containing signs from numeric offsets and test parsing behavior in the actual Python environment. Do not assume a helper recalled from a later Django version exists at the source revision; preserve the complete submitted patch.

assumptions.statement: The original PostgreSQL _prepare_tzname_delta replaces every plus sign with minus if a plus is present; otherwise it replaces every minus with plus if a minus is present.

scope.inputs: tzname string containing a plus, or containing a minus and no plus

assumptions.statement: The recorded parse_time("10") call returns datetime.time(10, 0).
assumptions.workspace_context: Intermediate checkout after timezone/backend edits; dateparse.py has not been edited in the recorded commands.
